## Project

AI automation system combining probabilistic decision-making with deterministic script execution

## How This Project Works

Skills live in `.claude/skills/<skill-name>/`. Each skill has:
- `SKILL.md` — instructions and workflow
- `scripts/` — deterministic Python/Node scripts to execute

Always read `SKILL.md` before suggesting how to run a skill. Run scripts from their own directory.

## Key Conventions

- Never edit `.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, or `.github/copilot-instructions.md` directly — they are generated from `.template/`
- Source of truth for config is `project.config.json`
- Reusable prompts are in `.prompts/`
- User context (interests, voice, stack) is in `context/`
- Temporary files go in `.tmp/` (never commit)
- Deliverables go to cloud services (Google Sheets, Medium, LinkedIn), not local files
